correctness.rationale: The n edge molecule vectors have one positive circuit relation and unimodular deleted-column determinants; for generic weights every facet contains exactly d signed generators and the strict signed-sum test is necessary and sufficient, so cone volume additivity proves the first sum. Centered symmetric perturbations give half contributions at any simultaneous resonance by continuity of volume. The dual is an exact box section with determinant-one coordinate map; n-interval convolution and inclusion-exclusion give the second sum. The centered-sum local CLT and the central-binomial estimate prove the limit. The packaged script independently constructs primal and polar hulls for eleven rational length lists and exactly evaluates determinants. SciPy facet triangulation is not an all-dim proof and is explicitly limited.

value.rationale: The Mahler volume product is a natural affine invariant of normed spaces and is explicitly studied for finite Lipschitz-free spaces in arxiv:1911.10642. This resolves its exact two-volume profile for the complete natural family of positive weighted cycles, including all metric-redundant edges and simultaneous wall resonances; it also quantifies a nontrivial asymptotic ratio 2 sqrt(3)/pi to the cross-polytope benchmark. Computing both the primal circuit-cone volume and the polar box-spline volume is not a routine consequence of the facet classification. A comprehensive invariant for unrestricted lengths supports mathematical comparisons across the family.
